audit.whatIsWrong: All seven rows read Sylas, but whys[0] says neither side wins Level 1, whys[1] and whys[2] describe Maokai out-trading him at 2-3, and whys[3] calls Levels 4-5 close.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Skill / Maokai / Maokai / Skill / Sylas / Sylas / Sylas — Sylas only takes over from 6 once Hijack and his first AP item land.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 3 to Skill, rows 1 and 2 to Maokai, as one atomic group with matched content pairs and ratings.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Maokai's 2-3 punish, Sylas's level-6 Hijack stealing Nature's Grasp, his first AP item, and late AP scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Abscond/Abduct a 'dash + stun' in four places (breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, wants.foe[1], mid). Riot's E text has no stun. wants.foe[0] also credits Q with the drain — the healing is on W, Kingslayer.
audit.why: Riot's E: 'Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.' Riot's W: 'lunges at an enemy... healing himself against enemy champions.' Q, Chain Lash, only damages and slows. E is 13s at rank 1, W 12s.
audit.corrected: The invented stun removed and slots fixed in tldr, dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns, wants.foe[0] and wants.foe[1], with the real cooldowns.

audit.why: Kingslayer heals off champions, so the existing early-anti-heal instruction in report[8].t is the right answer and is already present.

edits.before: Bait his key tool — root him on the Abscond / Abduct cooldown and grind him with saplings. Maokai wins the Abscond / Abduct cooldown windows.
edits.after: Abscond is a dash he recasts as Abduct to yank himself to you — bait the recast, then W-root on its 13s and grind him with saplings.

edits.before: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Abscond dashes and the Abduct recast pulls him to you — no stun in it. Commit on its 13s.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sylas Abscond (13s at rank 1): a dash, and the Abduct recast pulls him onto you — it does not stun. - Kingslayer (12s) heals him off champions, so Grievous Wounds is the answer. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Stack Q (Chemtech) drain and W heal to win the sustained AP trade your Sap Magic can't out-grind
edits.after: Chip you with Chain Lash (Q) and heal off you with Kingslayer (W) to out-grind your Sap Magic

edits.before: Hold E chain-dash to break your W approach or stun you out of an all-in
edits.after: Hold Abscond to dodge your W, then Abduct back onto you once your root is down
